With the recent installation and commissioning of three state-of-the-art IGM Robotic Welding Systems at Bowhill Engineering, we are growing our Robotics Team & seek an additional Robotic Welder Operator


This is an exciting & unique
opportunity to work with world-class technology in our new B5 Fabrication Hall, contributing to the production of over 660 precision-engineered steel tunnel segments for the Torrens to Darlington
Project & future heavy structural steel projects.


Specialising in large government infrastructure projects and complexity done excellently, Bowhill
Engineering is powered by technology, driven by great people to optimize and build structures that matter.


About the Role
Advancing Bowhill Engineering’s robotic capabilities, a blend of technical skills, knowledge of welding processes, and familiarity with robotic programming and maintenance is key to success in this role.


Through the daily operating, maintaining, and programming you will ensure efficient, high-quality welds & products and look to increase cost effectiveness of manufacturing operations of our robotic welding systems. Proficiency with CAD software or similar tools, experience in quality control, and understanding of safety protocols are highly beneficial.


Sharing our big picture focus, on enhancing production efficiency, implementing improvements and increasing our robotic capabilities, you will play a key role in operating advanced robotic welding
cells, deliver high performance & specialized welding requirements to produce high-quality fabrication outcomes.


Key Responsibilities & Requirements
Ability to operate fully automated robotic welding systemsCapability to develop advanced offline and online welding programsStrong fault-finding and troubleshooting skillsStrong work ethic and commitment to quality


Robot Operator/Welder Experience & Qualification
Trade Certification (Welding or Fabrication) or relevant on-the-job welding experienceExperience reading and interpreting engineering drawingsHigh Risk Forklift Licence (highly desirable)


What We Offer
Cutting-edge robotic welding technologyWork Diversity - major infrastructure project of national significancePermanent position with long-term stabilityAnnual wage reviews and wage boost incentivesDay and Afternoon shifts available (Afternoon shift attracts a 15% loading on hourly rates)Relocation incentive or accommodation assistance *subject to conditionsEmployee Assistance Program (EAP)Employee Health AssistanceActive Social Club and strong team environmentCareer advancement opportunities within a growing organisationModern workplace with 5 workshops on siteEnjoy the River Murray lifestyleJoin the Employer of Choice in the Murraylands, with a great workplace culture and team

result.description:
Our valued client, ECS Solutions are seeking to employ suitably qualified Welders to join their busy team of professionals working out of their Murarrie depot.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
